We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: likely (1) sulfonamide formation (attach sulfonyl chloride to an aniline). (2) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the /C=C/C(=O)N...). (3) amide coupling to attach aniline to the acid.

Thus retrosynthesis: target -> break amide bond to give acid (aryl-alkene acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Then break the alkene formation to give aldehyde + malonic acid? Actually Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) attached to sulfonyl group? Wait the unsaturated acid is attached to sulfonyl phenyl ring: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group. The unsaturated acid part is the side chain attached to phenyl sulfone. So we can think: the sulfonyl phenyl ring (with para substituent) attached to the unsaturated acid side chain. The sulfonamide formation attaches the sulfonyl chloride to the aniline (the first phenyl with methyl). So step 1: sulfonamide formation: target -> break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride) attached to phenyl ring, and aniline (the methyl phenyl amine). So precursor 1: p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(N)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-Ph-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Wait the sulfonyl chloride would be ClSO2-Ph-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to the second phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So sulfonyl chloride precursor: ClSO2-c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. That's a sulfonyl chloride attached to that phenyl with side chain.

Step 2: amide coupling: break the amide C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated acid attached to phenyl sulfone: (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) with sulfonyl group? Actually the acid is the side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N... The amide is between the unsaturated acid carbonyl and aniline. So after breaking, we have the unsaturated acid: c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group (SO2). So precursor: sulfonyl phenyl with α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step 2: amide formation.

Step 3: Doebner modification: break the C=C double bond formation to give aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) attached to sulfonyl group, and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So precursor: sulfonyl phenyl aldehyde (Cl? no sulfonyl attached) actually the sulfonyl phenyl with aldehyde substituent: c2ccc(CHO)cc2 attached to sulfonyl group (SO2). So final precursors: p-toluidine, sulfonyl chloride phenyl aldehyde, malonic acid.

Thus we need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We can search for sulfonamide formation template (sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide). Use search with functional_groups_formed: sulfonamides, broken: amine? Let's search.
